column1: # R1 — unconditional refusal of the PROD ref and the PROD host, before detection.

# permissions.deny before it ever reached the hook and would pass for the wrong

# PROD over the Management API or the PROD data-plane host. All thirteen are
# closed by one pre-detection literal match, because the PROD host
# R1 closes these CASES. It does not close their ROOT CAUSES: k21, d6, qa20, d10
# and e2 still bypass in their DEV-ref and targetless spellings, which is R2a/R2b.
